name: hippus_settler
description: a Hippus Settler (Fall from Heaven), a moustached, bearded nomad with dark hair under a peaked orange fur hat with a cream fur brim, an orange coat with cream fur trim and a red sash, brown boots, carrying a huge cream backpack with a rolled bedroll on top and a copper pot hanging on its screen-left side, his RIGHT hand a fist gripping the pack strap at his chest, and a gnarled wooden walking staff in his LEFT hand
hands: the gnarled walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist at the pack strap on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the gnarled walking staff is lifted up over the head with its top pointing up and back, the big backpack still on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its gnarled top hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the pack strap
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its gnarled top pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the gnarled top of the walking staff smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its gnarled top nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the big backpack swaying
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward its upright resting angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out holding the walking staff upright), the big backpack jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the walking staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward under the big backpack, head droops, the walking staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the gnarled top of the walking staff resting on the ground, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the big backpack hitting the ground first
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the fur hat still on his head; the walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the big backpack and bedroll squashed behind his shoulders
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hanging pot rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the walking staff on the ground beside him, the backpack behind his shoulders
